evidence.title: CIP and Thylander start construction of energy-integrated data centre in Denmark backed by PensionDanmark
evidence.excerpt: CIP says it and Thylander are starting construction of Dansk Data Center 1 at the Port of Esbjerg, says DDC1 is being built there, and reports that its groundbreaking ceremony takes place on August 13, 2026.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 39773-byte content-decoded credential-free public CIP response body
metadata.capture_date_key_semantics: The evidence key retains the 2026-09-06 America/Los_Angeles research date; retrieved_at records the UTC response time.
physical_status_as_reported: The release title says CIP and Thylander start construction.
The release says the DDC1 groundbreaking ceremony takes place on August 13, 2026.
The notes to editors call DDC1 a data centre being built at the Port of Esbjerg.
metadata.physical_status_scope: The first-party owner and developer release supports one generic under_construction observation for the DDC1 current-build project as of 2026-08-13. It does not establish a finer construction substage, commissioning, completion, energization, occupancy, or operation.

corroboration.plexar_scope: First-party project participant Plexar says it marked the DDC1 groundbreaking the prior day.
corroboration.industry_scope: The Danish Data Center Industry association says construction has begun on DDC1 and that the first phase broke ground; this is corroboration, not the source of the normalized lifecycle row.

metadata.supersession_review: Fresh review through 2026-09-06 found no authoritative completion, commissioning, energization, occupancy, or operation event. Current participant material continues to target opening or commissioning in late 2027.

evidence.title: Dansk Datacenter 1 K/S - Digital Miljoeadministration
evidence.excerpt: The official Digital Environmental Administration facility record identifies Dansk Datacenter 1 K/S, CVR 45807061, at Sahara 9, 6700 Esbjerg, on cadastral parcel 1419o Esbjerg Bygrunde.
